```{r}
#1.
employee_demographics <- read.csv("survey_employee_demographics.csv", na = "")
employee_employment_details <- read_excel("survey_employee_employment_details.xlsx", na = "")
combined_data <- merge(employee_demographics, employee_employment_details, by = "RecordID", all = TRUE)
summary(combined_data)
```
```{r}
#2. 
#b/ 
# Initial data cleaning: trimming whitespace, converting to lowercase, and removing duplicates
cleaned_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    RecordID = str_trim(tolower(RecordID)),  
    across(where(is.character), ~ str_trim(tolower(.)))  
  ) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Convert specified columns to numeric and replace missing salary values with median
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(TotalYearsOfExperience, 
        YearsOfExperienceInGermany, 
        YearlyBonusAndStocksInEUR, 
        AnnualBonusAndStocksOneYearAgo, 
        NumberOfVacationDays), 
      as.numeric
    ),
    # Replace missing values in salary columns with their respective medians
    YearlySalaryInEUR = ifelse(is.na(YearlySalaryInEUR), median(YearlySalaryInEUR, na.rm = TRUE), YearlySalaryInEUR),
    AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo = ifelse(is.na(AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo), median(AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo, na.rm = TRUE), AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo)
  )

cleaned_data
```


```{r}
#3
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data %>%
  mutate(
    YearlySalaryInEUR = ifelse(is.infinite(YearlySalaryInEUR), NA, YearlySalaryInEUR),
    AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo = ifelse(is.infinite(AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo), NA, AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(YearlySalaryInEUR) & !is.na(AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo))

# Updated job role categorization with additional cleaning steps
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data %>%
  mutate(JobCategory = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "software engineer|backend developer|frontend developer|fullstack developer|full-stack developer|c/c++/java developer|embedded software engineer|mobile developer|ios developer|xr developer|software architekt|software architect|lead software developer|tech lead|technical lead|engineering team lead|staff engineer|software developer in test|fullstack engineer") ~ "Software Development",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "data engineer|big data engineer|data scientist|data analyst|business analyst|bi consultant|analytics engineer|data architect|data science manager|bi it consultant|bi developer|consultant data analytics|computational linguist") ~ "Data & Analytics",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "product manager|engineering manager|project manager|program manager|team lead|director of engineering|cto|vp engineering|head of engineering|head of it|manager|senior program manager|teamlead|team manager") ~ "Management",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "qa engineer|test manager|testautomation|software tester|qa lead|testmanager|qa manager") ~ "Quality Assurance",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "system administrator|network engineer|security engineer|devops|cloud architect|infrastructure engineer|security manager|sre|network administrator|systemadministrator|senior network&security engineer") ~ "Infrastructure & Security",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "consultant|technical account manager|support engineer|erp consultant|application consultant|sap consultant|it operations manager|bi consultant") ~ "Consulting & Support",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "recruiter|tech recruiting") ~ "Recruiting",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "designer|ui/ux") ~ "Design",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "sales|software sales") ~ "Sales",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "researcher|computer vision researcher|chief research officer|professor|ai management") ~ "Research",
    
    str_detect(tolower(Position), "agile master|agile coach") ~ "Agile & Coaching",
    
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

identify_outliers <- function(x) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  return(c(lower_bound, upper_bound))
}

outliers_2020 <- identify_outliers(cleaned_data$YearlySalaryInEUR)
outliers_2019 <- identify_outliers(cleaned_data$AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo)

cleaned_data_no_outliers <- cleaned_data %>%
  filter(
    YearlySalaryInEUR >= outliers_2020[1] & 
    YearlySalaryInEUR <= outliers_2020[2] &
    AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo >= outliers_2019[1] & 
    AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo <= outliers_2019[2]
  )


cleaned_data_no_outliers <- cleaned_data_no_outliers[!is.na(cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory) & !is.na(cleaned_data_no_outliers$YearlySalaryInEUR), ]

cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory_2020 <- reorder(
  cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory, 
  cleaned_data_no_outliers$YearlySalaryInEUR, 
  FUN = median, 
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory_2019 <- reorder(
  cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory, 
  cleaned_data_no_outliers$AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo, 
  FUN = median, 
  na.rm = TRUE
)

boxplot_jobcat_2020 <- ggplot(cleaned_data_no_outliers, aes(x = JobCategory_2020, y = YearlySalaryInEUR / 1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#FFA500", color = "black", outlier.shape = 8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Salary by Job Role (2020) - Sorted by Median",
       x = "Job Role", y = "Annual Salary (Thousands EUR)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory_2020))  # Ensure the categories are ordered by median

print(boxplot_jobcat_2020)

boxplot_jobcat_2019 <- ggplot(cleaned_data_no_outliers, aes(x = JobCategory_2019, y = AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo / 1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#FFA500", color = "black", outlier.shape = 8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Salary by Job Role (2019) - Sorted by Median",
       x = "Job Role", y = "Annual Salary (Thousands EUR)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(cleaned_data_no_outliers$JobCategory_2019))  # Ensure the categories are ordered by median

print(boxplot_jobcat_2019)

median_salary_2020 <- cleaned_data_no_outliers %>%
  group_by(JobCategory) %>%
  summarize(Median_Salary_2020 = median(YearlySalaryInEUR, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(Median_Salary_2020)

median_salary_2019 <- cleaned_data_no_outliers %>%
  group_by(JobCategory) %>%
  summarize(Median_Salary_2019 = median(AnnualSalaryOneYearAgo, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(Median_Salary_2019)

median_salary_comparison <- median_salary_2020 %>%
  left_join(median_salary_2019, by = "JobCategory")

print(median_salary_comparison)
```

```{r}
#4.
cleaned_data_no_outliers <- cleaned_data_no_outliers %>%
  filter(!is.na(TotalYearsOfExperience) & !is.na(YearsOfExperienceInGermany))

cleaned_data_no_outliers <- cleaned_data_no_outliers %>%
  mutate(ExperienceRange = case_when(
    TotalYearsOfExperience >= 0 & TotalYearsOfExperience < 1 ~ "0-1 years",
    TotalYearsOfExperience >= 1 & TotalYearsOfExperience < 3 ~ "1-3 years",
    TotalYearsOfExperience >= 3 & TotalYearsOfExperience < 5 ~ "3-5 years",
    TotalYearsOfExperience >= 5 & TotalYearsOfExperience < 10 ~ "5-10 years",
    TotalYearsOfExperience >= 10 & TotalYearsOfExperience < 20 ~ "10-20 years",
    TotalYearsOfExperience >= 20 ~ "20+ years",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

cleaned_data_no_outliers <- cleaned_data_no_outliers %>%
  mutate(ExperienceGermanyRange = case_when(
    YearsOfExperienceInGermany >= 0 & YearsOfExperienceInGermany < 1 ~ "0-1 years",
    YearsOfExperienceInGermany >= 1 & YearsOfExperienceInGermany < 3 ~ "1-3 years",
    YearsOfExperienceInGermany >= 3 & YearsOfExperienceInGermany < 5 ~ "3-5 years",
    YearsOfExperienceInGermany >= 5 & YearsOfExperienceInGermany < 10 ~ "5-10 years",
    YearsOfExperienceInGermany >= 10 & YearsOfExperienceInGermany < 20 ~ "10-20 years",
    YearsOfExperienceInGermany >= 20 ~ "20+ years",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

plot_total_exp_2020 <- ggplot(cleaned_data_no_outliers, aes(x = factor(ExperienceRange, 
                                                                levels = c("0-1 years", "1-3 years", "3-5 years", 
                                                                           "5-10 years", "10-20 years", "20+ years")), 
                                                   y = YearlySalaryInEUR / 1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#FFA500", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Annual Salary Distribution (2020) by Total Experience",
       x = "Experience Range",
       y = "Annual Salary (Thousands EUR)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

plot_german_exp_2020 <- ggplot(cleaned_data_no_outliers, aes(x = factor(ExperienceGermanyRange, 
                                                                levels = c("0-1 years", "1-3 years", "3-5 years", 
                                                                           "5-10 years", "10-20 years", "20+ years")), 
                                                   y = YearlySalaryInEUR / 1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#FFA500", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Annual Salary Distribution (2020) by Experience in Germany",
       x = "Experience in Germany Range",
       y = "Annual Salary (Thousands EUR)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)


plot_category_exp_2020 <- ggplot(cleaned_data_no_outliers, 
                                aes(x = factor(ExperienceRange,
                                             levels = c("0-1 years", "1-3 years", "3-5 years",
                                                      "5-10 years", "10-20 years", "20+ years")),
                                    y = YearlySalaryInEUR / 1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = JobCategory)) +
  facet_wrap(~ JobCategory, scales = "free_y") +

  theme_minimal() +

    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),

    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3")

print(plot_total_exp_2020)
print(plot_german_exp_2020)
```

```{r}
#5.
cleaned_data_no_outliers <- cleaned_data_no_outliers %>%
  mutate(ProgrammingCategory = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "javascript|js") ~ "JavaScript",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "typescript|ts") ~ "TypeScript",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "python|django") ~ "Python",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "^java$|^java,|,java") ~ "Java",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "c\\+\\+|cpp") ~ "C++",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "c#|\\.net") ~ "C#",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "go|golang") ~ "Go",
    str_detect(tolower(YourMainProgrammingLanguage), "sql") ~ "SQL",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  mutate(MainLanguageAtWork = case_when(
    MainLanguageAtWork == "english" ~ "english",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "german" ~ "german",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "russian" ~ "russian",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "polish" ~ "polish",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "czech" ~ "czech",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "italian" ~ "italian",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "french" ~ "french",
    MainLanguageAtWork == "spanish" ~ "spanish",
    MainLanguageAtWork %in% c("english and german", "deuglisch") ~ "English & German",
    MainLanguageAtWork %in% c("russian, english", "pусский") ~ "Russian & English",
    MainLanguageAtWork %in% c("50/50", "both") ~ "Multiple Languages",  
    is.na(MainLanguageAtWork) ~ "Missing", 
    TRUE ~ "Other" 
  ))%>%

  mutate(CompanySizeCategory = case_when(
    CompanySize %in% c("up to 10", "11-50") ~ "Small (<50)",
    CompanySize %in% c("51-100", "101-1000") ~ "Medium (51-1000)",
    CompanySize == "1000+" ~ "Large (1000+)",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  mutate(CompanyTypeCategory = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(CompanyType), "product|startup|saas|faang") ~ "Tech Product/ Startups",
    str_detect(tolower(CompanyType), "consult|service|outsource") ~ "Consulting/Services",
    str_detect(tolower(CompanyType), "bank|fintech|finance|insurance") ~ "Finance/Fintech",
    str_detect(tolower(CompanyType), "corporate|enterprise") ~ "Corporate/Enterprise",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
```
